name: combat_achievements
description: Combat achievement tasks with per-task completion, decoded from the game's own task tables (no interface needed). Unfiltered this is all six tiers and ~655 tasks - a large response - so FILTER IT: tier plus completed:false answers 'what do I have left at this tier', which is the usual question. Tier summary counts are always returned in full, filtered or not, so a narrow response is still interpretable. For just the per-tier totals, game_state already carries them and is cheaper than calling this.

tier.description: Only this tier. Omit for all six.

completed.description: true for finished tasks only, false for remaining ones only. Omit for both. 'What's left' is completed:false.

search.description: Only tasks whose name contains this text, case-insensitive (e.g. 'Zulrah').

capturedAt.description: ISO-8601 instant, UTC. Transported as a JSON string; no native date-time type is implied.

tiers.description: One entry per tier, in difficulty order.

tierCompleted.description: The tier's completion varbit, i.e. every task in it is done.

tasksCompleted.description: Completed tasks in this tier, ignoring any filter.

taskCount.description: Total tasks in this tier, ignoring any filter.

id.description: Task struct id from the game's table.

tasksReturned.description: How many tasks the tasks array actually holds. Present only when a filter dropped some; absent means tasks is complete for the tier.

filter.description: Echo of the filter applied. Absent when the response is unfiltered.
